% Log-only native hboxes; kept outside the rendered fixture directory.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\newcommand{\probe}[3]{\begingroup#2\setbox0=\hbox{$#3$}%
  \typeout{OPBOX:#1;\the\wd0;\the\ht0;\the\dp0}\endgroup}
\begin{document}
\probe{round}{}{\operatorname{round}(-2.5)}
\probe{mod}{}{\operatorname{mod}(-5,3)}
\probe{op-glue}{}{a\operatorname{rank} A}
\probe{op-parens}{}{\operatorname{Var}(X)}
\probe{one-letter}{}{\operatorname{f}x}
\probe{kern}{}{\operatorname{arg\,min} x}
\probe{punctuation}{}{\operatorname{a-b*c:d/e.f}x}
\probe{script}{}{\operatorname{rank}_k A}
\probe{supsub}{}{\operatorname{rank}^2_k A}
\probe{sin-square}{}{\sin^2 x}
\probe{scriptstyle}{}{\scriptstyle\operatorname{round}(-2.5)}
\probe{small}{\scriptsize}{\operatorname{round}(-2.5)}
\probe{large}{\Large}{\operatorname{round}(-2.5)}
\probe{bold}{\boldmath}{\operatorname{round}(-2.5)}
\probe{nested}{}{\frac{\operatorname{Var}(X)}{\operatorname{rank} A}}
\probe{ligature-diff}{}{\operatorname{diff}(x)}
\probe{ligature-fi}{}{\operatorname{fi}x}
\probe{declared-Re}{}{\operatorname{Re}(p_0)}
\end{document}
